name: Vim
summary: Vim allows AI use only for research, small targeted fixes and help with tests, with AI use disclosed via an `Assisted-by:` trailer and the contributor fully understanding and answering for every line. Large mostly-generated pull requests, AI-written commit messages or PR descriptions, pasted AI answers to review questions and AI-written reviews of others' pull requests are not acceptable.

evidence.quote: Research, looking things up, understanding existing code.
Use of AI is allowed within the limits mentioned below, but you remain fully responsible for everything you submit. Disclosure of AI use is required, using an `Assisted-by:` trailer.
Small, targeted fixes (e.g. for security issues).
You must understand every line of your change and be able to explain it.
Help with writing tests and benchmarks.
Large pull requests that were mostly generated.
Generated commit messages or PR descriptions.
Answering review questions by pasting AI output.
Posting AI-generated reviews on other people's pull requests.
Fixing spelling, grammar and translations is fine.
Maintainers decide whether a contribution is acceptable.
You must have the right to submit the code under the Vim license.
